cards.intuition: Process a whole query-term posting list and add its contribution to document accumulators.
Advance term iterators in document order and finalize one candidate's combined score at a time.
cards.formula: score(d) = sum over query iterators positioned at d

cards.intuition: Once a size-k min-heap is full, its smallest score is the value a challenger must beat.
cards.formula: theta = min score in current top-k heap

cards.intuition: Preselect the documents with the strongest term-local weights to shrink runtime candidate generation.
cards.formula: champion(t,r) = top r documents by w(t,d)

cards.intuition: A smaller list saves scoring work but raises the chance of excluding an exhaustive top result.
cards.formula: smaller r: lower cost, potentially lower top-k recall

cards.intuition: Search a high-value tier first, but expand when its results are not provably or empirically sufficient.
cards.formula: search tier 2 if tier 1 stopping condition fails

cards.intuition: Skip a candidate when the maximum score it could still assemble cannot beat the heap threshold.
cards.formula: skip if sum relevant upper bounds <= theta

cards.intuition: Accumulate bounds in current document order; the first identifier whose cumulative bound beats the threshold is the pivot.
cards.formula: pivot = first current doc where cumulative UB > theta

cards.intuition: Delay terms whose combined maximum cannot make a candidate competitive, consulting them only when needed.
cards.formula: nonessential if remaining UB cannot cross theta

cards.intuition: Local posting-block maxima are tighter than a term-wide maximum and enable longer safe skips.
Every positive first-stage feature must be covered by a sound upper bound or a true winner can disappear.
cards.formula: stored UB >= maximum attainable score contribution
